A '''copper mattock''' is the [[Copper equipment|copper]] [[mattock]], crafted from [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]]. It mines at speed 5 and has 350 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/copper_mattock.json}}</ref>

As a [[mattock]], it works as both a shovel and a hoe, at a lower mining speed than the copper shovel or hoe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/copper/mattock</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both shovel and hoe blocks at speed 5.

In Matcha Flavoured, hoes also mine wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 1 damage with an attack speed of 2.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Copper Ingot|copper ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/copper_ingot_from_blasting_copper_materials.json}}</ref>
